title: [Impeller] Metal: PipelineLibraryMTL pipeline map is accessed from two threads without a lock (crash with Flutter GPU)
body:
### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a macOS app from the code sample below and enable Flutter GPU (`FLTEnableFlutterGPU` in `Info.plist`).
2. Run it. A Flutter GPU scene draws every frame while the overlay keeps creating new Impeller pipeline variants (blurred text shadow, backdrop blur, changing blend mode).

A normal run crashes only rarely. With a ThreadSanitizer engine (`tools/gn ... --tsan`) the race is reported within seconds.

### Expected results

Flutter GPU and Impeller can request pipelines at the same time without a race, as on Vulkan, where `PipelineLibraryVK` locks its maps.

### Actual results

`PipelineLibraryMTL` reads and writes `pipelines_` with no lock (still true on master). Flutter GPU looks pipelines up on the UI thread (`RenderPass::Draw` → `GetPipeline`) while the raster thread inserts new variants (`ContentContext` → `CreateVariant` → `GetPipeline`), so a lookup can hit a rehash.

- We hit it once in a release app on 3.47.1: `SIGSEGV` in `unordered_map::find`, while the raster thread was building a pipeline for the first blurred text shadow.
- TSan reports the race in the code sample on master.
- An engine test that looks pipelines up while two threads add new ones fails, hangs or crashes without a lock, and passes 40/40 with one.

`SamplerLibraryMTL` and `PipelineLibraryGLES` look similar and will be reported separately.

### Code sample

<details><summary>pubspec.yaml and lib/main.dart</summary>

`pubspec.yaml`:

```yaml
name: gpu_pipeline_race
publish_to: none

environment:
  sdk: ^3.13.0

dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  flutter_scene: 0.23.0
  vector_math: ^2.4.3

flutter:
  uses-material-design: true
```

`lib/main.dart`:

```dart
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:flutter_scene/scene.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math.dart' as vm;

void main() => runApp(const MaterialApp(home: Repro()));

class Repro extends StatefulWidget {
  const Repro({super.key});

  @override
  State<Repro> createState() => _ReproState();
}

class _ReproState extends State<Repro> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  final Scene scene = Scene();
  late final Ticker ticker;
  int frame = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final geometry = CuboidGeometry(vm.Vector3.all(0.4));
    final materials = [UnlitMaterial(), PhysicallyBasedMaterial()];
    for (var i = 0; i < 400; i++) {
      scene.add(
        Node(mesh: Mesh(geometry, materials[i % 2]))
          ..localTransform = vm.Matrix4.translation(
            vm.Vector3((i % 20 - 10) * 0.6, 0, (i ~/ 20 - 10) * 0.6),
          ),
      );
    }
    ticker = createTicker((_) => setState(() => frame++))..start();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ticker.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final mode = BlendMode.values[frame % BlendMode.values.length];
    return Stack(
      children: [
        Positioned.fill(
          child: SceneView(
            scene,
            camera: PerspectiveCamera(
              position: vm.Vector3(0, 10, 14),
              target: vm.Vector3.zero(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        Positioned(
          left: 20,
          top: 20,
          width: 300,
          height: 200,
          child: ColorFiltered(
            colorFilter: ColorFilter.mode(Colors.teal, mode),
            child: ClipRect(
              child: BackdropFilter(
                filter: ui.ImageFilter.blur(
                  sigmaX: 1.0 + frame % 20,
                  sigmaY: 1.0 + frame % 20,
                ),
                blendMode: mode,
                child: Text(
                  'frame $frame',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 40,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    shadows: [
                      Shadow(blurRadius: 1.0 + frame % 40, color: Colors.black),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

</details>

### Screenshots or Video

N/A (crash).

### Logs

<details><summary>Crash and TSan stacks</summary>

Release crash, 3.47.1 (`EXC_BAD_ACCESS` at `0x3f800000`):

```console
Thread 0 Crashed (main / UI thread):
  std::unordered_map<PipelineDescriptor, PipelineFuture<...>>::find
  impeller::PipelineLibraryMTL::GetPipeline
  flutter::gpu::RenderPass::GetOrCreatePipeline
  flutter::gpu::RenderPass::Draw
Thread 6 (io.flutter.raster), same moment:
  -[AGXG16XFamilyDevice newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:completionHandler:]
  impeller::PipelineLibraryMTL::GetPipeline
  impeller::Pipeline<PipelineDescriptor>::CreateVariant
  impeller::ContentContext::GetTexturePipeline
  impeller::GaussianBlurFilterContents::RenderFilter
  impeller::TextShadowCache::Lookup
```

TSan, code sample on master d03768e:

```console
WARNING: ThreadSanitizer: data race
  Read by main thread:
    __hash_table::find
    impeller::PipelineLibraryMTL::GetPipeline
    flutter::gpu::RenderPass::GetOrCreatePipeline
  Previous write by thread T7 (raster):
    __hash_table::__emplace_unique_key_args
    impeller::PipelineLibraryMTL::GetPipeline
    impeller::Pipeline<PipelineDescriptor>::CreateVariant
    impeller::ContentContext::GetTexturePipeline
```

</details>
